cards.front: 1. Nguyen Thuc Thuy Tien left a positive impression on both judges and _____ because of her friendliness and natural beauty.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. audience = khán giả nói chung của một chương trình/sự kiện.

A. spectators = khán giả xem trực tiếp một sự kiện
B. viewers = người xem truyền hình/video
C. audience = khán giả nói chung
D. passer-by = người qua đường

cards.front: 2. When he was a teenager, he _____ at the local theatre in his home town during the tourist season.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. performed = biểu diễn.

Cụm phù hợp: perform at a theatre.

cards.front: 3. She has joined the panel of _____ the popular TV talent show.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. judges.

Cụm tự nhiên: a panel of judges = ban giám khảo.

cards.front: 4. I didn't enjoy the performance because I couldn't _____ with any of the main characters.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. identify.

Cụm: identify with somebody = đồng cảm / thấy mình giống với ai.

cards.front: 5. Judges travel all round America _____ search of the best singers and bring them to Hollywood.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. in.

Cụm cố định: in search of = để tìm kiếm.

cards.front: 6. Can you play any _____? - Yes. I can play the flute and the guitar.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. musical instruments = nhạc cụ.

Flute và guitar đều là musical instruments.

cards.front: 7. Two of the four contestants will be _____ after tonight's show.
cards.explanation: ✓ C. eliminated = bị loại khỏi cuộc thi.

cards.front: 8. Our music teacher has been invited to be a _____ in many music competitions and talent shows.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. judge = giám khảo.

Cụm: be a judge in a competition/talent show.

cards.front: 9. American singer Michael Jackson made a record when he had got 13 Billboard Hot 100 number-one _____.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. singles = các đĩa đơn/bài hát phát hành đơn.

Sau số 13 cần danh từ số nhiều.

cards.front: 10. The judges _____ an important role in the competition.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. play.

Cụm cố định: play an important role in = đóng vai trò quan trọng trong.

cards.front: 11. The X-factor is a television singing competition _____ in the United Kingdom.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. originating.

“originating in the United Kingdom” = có nguồn gốc từ Vương quốc Anh.

cards.front: 12. Lina, the _____ album of the new music band in our city, will be uploaded on the website next week. I’m looking forward to listening to it.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. debut = đầu tay.

Cụm: debut album = album đầu tay.

cards.front: 13. I passionately love the show “Familiar Faces” and this is the 4th _____ I’ve seen.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. season = mùa của một chương trình truyền hình.

“the 4th season” = mùa thứ tư.

cards.front: 14. This concert marks nine years since the death of Trinh Cong Son, a prominent _____ of modern Vietnamese music.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. figure = nhân vật nổi bật/quan trọng.

Cụm: a prominent figure of/in ...

cards.front: 15. The best singer _____ went to Alan Walker for “Faded”.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. award = giải thưởng.

Cụm tự nhiên: an award goes to somebody.

cards.front: 16. Van Cao’s “Tien Quan Ca” was made into the national _____ of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. anthem.

Cụm: national anthem = quốc ca.

cards.front: 17. Fantasia Barrino, the winner of American Idol’s season 3 in 2004, released her Free Yourself which earned three Grammy Award nominations.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. debut album = album đầu tay.

“Free Yourself” là tên một album được phát hành.

cards.front: 18. The “Marching song” was adopted as the national _____ of Viet Nam in 1945.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. anthem = quốc ca.

Cụm: national anthem.

cards.front: 19. I’m a fan of _____ music. It consists of simple tunes so it is easy to listen and remember.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. pop music.

Pop music thường có giai điệu đơn giản, dễ nghe và dễ nhớ.

cards.front: 20. The _____ cheered loudly when the singers came out on the stage.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. audience = khán giả của buổi biểu diễn.

The audience có thể dùng như một tập thể khán giả.
